prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1379; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the above-referenced individual in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision involving your insured. The collision was a low-speed head-on impact, and our client has since been under medical care for injuries that are still being evaluated. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any other policies that may apply to this loss. We also ask that you confirm in writing that your insured has been notified of this claim.

Please preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, witness statements, the claim file, recorded statements, repair and salvage records, and all communications with your insured. Failure to preserve this material may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt response.
